sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:218522-Db
Chief Justice's Court

Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 3694 of 2023
Petitioner :- Malik Azizullah And 4 Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- A.P.Singh,Sangam Lal Kesharwani

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Santosh Kr. Singh Paliwal
Hon'ble Pritinker Diwaker,Chief Justice
Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The petitioners, by means of this writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, are before this Court with a prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 21.09.2022 in Case Crime No.105 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act,
Police Station- Parsamalik, District- Maharajganj.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this Court vide order dated 13.03.2023 had referred the matter to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
In compliance of the Court's order, settlement/agreement was arrived at between the parties on 07.10.2023.

A copy of the Malik Azizullah And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182366253/
1 same is on record.

entities.text: Malik Azizullah And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Perusal of the settlement/agreement, reveals that the parties have amicably settled their dispute and further agreed to withdraw all the cases pending between them.

The said fact has been mentioned in Paragraph Nos. 7 & 8 of the settlement/agreement dated 07.10.2023.
4.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and taking into account the settlement/agreement arrived at between the parties on 07.10.2023 before the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court, the proceedings in the aforesaid case are hereby quashed.
5. The writ petition is accordingly allowed.
